text: But you see, I am sore myself; that horse is the pride of my heart, to say nothing of his being such a favorite with the master and mistress; and to think that his life may be flung away in this manner is more than I can bear. But if you think I am hard on the boy I will try to give him a good word to-morrow--that is, I mean if Beauty is better.” “Well, John, thank you. I knew you did not wish to be too hard, and I am glad you see it was only ignorance.” John's voice almost startled me as he answered: “Only ignorance! only ignorance! how can you talk about only ignorance?
